cards.title: Half-filled disordered spinless-fermion Hamiltonian

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 2, Eq. (1) and following paragraph

derived_from: fermionic anticommutation signs for periodic hops
cards.numerical_form: real symmetric C(L,L/2) by C(L,L/2) matrix with V=2 and t=t'=1

checks.reason: Eq. (1), half filling, periodic boundaries and all printed couplings were transcribed directly from the manuscript.
Canonical creation/annihilation parity yields an exactly Hermitian matrix for every tested size.
Basis dimensions 70, 252, 924, 3432 and 12870 equal the exact binomial dimensions.

cards.title: Fixed-sample-RMS Gaussian disorder ensemble
cards.latex: w_i=W x_i/sqrt(L^{-1} sum_j x_j^2),  x_i sim N(0,1)
derived_from: the paper conditions each sample to have mean-square potential exactly W^2
cards.numerical_form: deterministic seeded normal draw followed by exact RMS rescaling

checks.reason: The manuscript explicitly distinguishes this conditioned ensemble from unconditioned Gaussian disorder.
Unit tests verify sqrt(mean(w_i^2)) equals W to 1e-14.

cards.title: Adjacent-gap ratio and limiting ensembles

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf p. 3, Eqs. (2)-(3), Fig. 1 discussion and footnote 17

cards.numerical_form: all interior adjacent gaps of every full spectrum; analytic Poisson density; independent GOE eigenspectra

checks.reason: Eqs. (2)-(3), the Poisson density/mean and the GOE mean are printed in the manuscript.
Numerical quadrature gives integral 1 and mean 2 ln 2 - 1 for the printed Poisson density.
The v2 independent GOE campaign gives mean 0.532583, within 0.003083 of the printed 0.5295.
W=3 is closer to GOE while W=11 is closer to Poisson for the generated interacting model.

cards.title: Disorder average, standard error and finite-size crossings

source_refs.value: raw/paper.pdf pp. 3-4, Fig. 2 method and discussion

derived_from: equal weighting of all many-body eigenenergies
linear interpolation of adjacent size-curve sign changes
cards.numerical_form: streamed sample means and variances with exact sample-ID coverage; crossing interpolation in the declared W window

checks.reason: The manuscript defines the per-sample spectral average, disorder average and standard statistical uncertainty, then discusses the crossing drift in Fig. 2.
Every declared sample ID appears exactly once and every size crosses from GOE-like to Poisson-like mean r.
Crossings drift from W=4.0,r=0.4972 to W=6.9168,r=0.4391 as size increases, matching the paper's qualitative conclusion.

open_questions: The exact W grid and L=10,12 disorder realization counts are not printed; paper-exact crossing coordinates cannot be claimed.
